name: termius-mcp
description: Read terminals, run commands and follow SFTP uploads in an already-open macOS Termius 9.38.1, through its local debugging port

cdp_port.title: Termius debug port
cdp_port.description: Loopback port Termius was started with (--remote-debugging-port). The plugin never opens it.

hostkey.title: First-time host keys
hostkey.description: What connect_host does with a first-time host-key prompt: ask leaves it to you; add or once accept it. A changed key is never accepted.

connect_allow.title: Hosts connect_host may open
connect_allow.description: Comma-separated saved host labels. Empty allows any saved host; existing terminals are not restricted.

upload_roots.title: Upload directories
upload_roots.description: Colon-separated absolute directories sftp_upload may read from. Empty allows any path outside credential stores such as ~/.ssh, which are always refused.

session_label.title: Label in claim listings
session_label.description: How this client appears when it holds a terminal claim.
